video.title: AI欧腐《摔进我心里：队长的秘密/Wrestling My Heart：The Captain's Secret》
video.desc:
Evan, a gay teen artist, is forced by his wrestling coach father to join the team under captain Kane — a tough kid from a broken home who needs the tournament prize to escape poverty. Hostility turns to attraction through brutal practices and intimate moments. When Kane's girlfriend Linda catches them kissing, she threatens to expose them; Evan and Kane fight back by revealing her exam cheating. But under pressure from his alcoholic mother, Kane steals Evan's father's watch. He wins the tournament — then is arrested. Devastated, Evan breaks it off. A week later, Kane is released, his mother sober. He races to the bus station as Evan leaves for an art program. "Liking you was never a mistake." They kiss on the platform and step onto the bus together, hand in hand.
同性恋少年画家Evan被身为摔跤教练的父亲强迫加入校队，并在队长Kane的带领下训练。
Kane出身破碎家庭，性格强硬，为了摆脱贫困，必须赢下比赛奖金。起初，两人彼此敌视，却在一次次残酷训练和暧昧相处中，慢慢从冲突走向心动。
当Kane的女友Linda撞见两人接吻后，她威胁要公开他们的关系。Evan和Kane选择反击，揭露了她考试作弊的真相。
可在酗酒母亲的压力下，Kane偷走了Evan父亲的手表。他虽然赢得了比赛，却也因此被捕。伤心欲绝的Evan选择与他分手。
一周后，Kane获释，母亲也终于戒酒清醒。当Evan即将前往艺术项目时，Kane一路追到车站，对他说：“喜欢你，从来都不是一个错误。”
